name: Cathie Wood
style: Buys fast growing disruptive tech (AI, robotics, genomics, crypto, space) and holds through big swings.
why_follow: ARK publishes its ETF trades every day, so you can see buys and sells within a day instead of waiting for the 13F. Caveat: her picks are high risk and volatile, and rising rates hurt this style the most.

bought.name: SpaceX
bought.note: New after the June 12 IPO, about 4.5 million shares. Now about 5% of the book.

bought.name: Cerebras Systems
bought.note: About $46 million bought in mid May, per daily trade reports.

sold.name: AMD
sold.note: Cut by about 1.3 million shares. More than $28 million of AMD and TSM sold in May.

sold.name: Tesla
sold.note: Trimmed, though still the top holding. ARK bought about $41 million back in early July.

view: In her January 2026 outlook she called the US economy a 'coiled spring' that could bounce back powerfully over the next few years, helped by tax cuts and deregulation.
